requirements.title: Budgets, deterministic cancellation and process ownership
Legacy correspondence and no shell execution

cases.name: Static/local mode detection
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Open hosted reader; launch with omitted profile on Windows and WSL, launch each valid explicit profile, reject invalid OS/profile pairs, and query health/runtime with and without credentials.
expected: Static has disabled live actions and makes no API request; local binds only 127.0.0.1:8765; omission selects only the OS CPU profile; CUDA requires explicit wsl-cuda plus passing preflight; profile is instance-immutable with no fallback; health is minimal; runtime/status/P00 fields match the selected profile.

cases.name: Fixed service-worker boundary
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Submit one fixture for every operation while recording service imports, child argv/environment and dispatch.
Submit command, module, URL and uploaded-code fields.
expected: Service process imports no ML backend; every job uses fixed isolated worker and allowlisted environment; unknown/code-bearing inputs fail before spawn.

cases.name: Pairing, origin and expiry
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Exercise valid, expired and reused 120-second bootstrap; idle and absolute test clocks; hostile Host, Origin, preflight, missing bearer and CSRF; reload same tab.
expected: Only one valid exchange succeeds; hostile requests fail before body parse; credentials persist only sessionStorage; two-hour idle, 12-hour absolute and restart invalidate exactly as specified.

cases.name: Storage traversal and atomic commit
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Use symlink/weak-permission roots; path, link, duplicate, sparse, bomb and traversal archives; inject failure before rename and before metadata commit.
expected: Unsafe roots/members are rejected; no write escapes root; no metadata points to partial bytes; committed bytes remain immutable and digest-addressed.

cases.name: Every request boundary
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: For JSON, dataset, bundle, record, UTF-8, prompt and chat limits submit exact-limit and limit-plus-one fixtures plus duplicate-key/nonfinite/trailing JSON.
expected: Exact limits are accepted when otherwise valid; plus-one and malformed inputs return the frozen code/status and create no job or dataset.

cases.name: Registry pagination and uploads
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Import a valid three-part dataset and a bad final part; page tied records with limit 1; reuse cursor with changed filter; stage an inert bundle.

Create/update/conflict/read progress; create/update/list/delete-preview/delete notes and conversations; append a turn; create/verify/assess evidence; preview/apply v1 and v2 progress; create capstone attempt; export selected backup.

Read startup preflight; commit a completed conversation generation atomically; reject partial generation; export a conversation dataset candidate; inspect capstone creation response versus later detail.
expected: Dataset commit is all-or-nothing; ordering/cursor has no gaps or duplicates; changed cursor fails; staging asserts transport safety only.

Every learner action has one callable closed-schema endpoint; revision conflicts do not mutate; delete requires fresh confirmed preview and tombstones content; migration preview is nonmutating and apply is atomic; sealed token and backup exclude credentials.

Preflight exposes fixed checks without host paths; generation commits user+assistant or neither; exported conversation cannot train before dataset audit; release token appears once and detail retains freeze/exposure without secret.

cases.name: Idempotent job creation and disk reserve
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Submit identical and changed bodies under one key; expire session and replay; mock available bytes at estimate+1GiB and one byte below for each estimate class.
Replay create, update, apply and delete mutations for learner-state endpoints with identical and changed idempotency bodies; fill each registry to its exact cap.
expected: Identical replay returns original; changed conflicts; exact reserve accepts; one-byte-below rejects without row/event.
All mutation replays are stable; changed body conflicts; next item at quota returns REGISTRY_LIMIT before row/bytes change.

cases.name: FIFO, ninth queued and transitions
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Block worker, enqueue eight jobs, submit ninth; cancel queued; drive completed, failed, interrupted paths; repeat cancel on all terminal states.
expected: One active/eight queued; ninth 429; FIFO stable; only declared transitions occur; terminal states never change.

cases.name: Cancellation, deadline and unrelated process
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Run signed tiny-v2 diagnosis preset; observe step-25 checkpoint/hold, cancel, and separately let 10-minute clock expire; exercise 60-minute deadline and hard-stop grace; keep unrelated Python sentinel.
expected: Cancel yields interrupted step25 checkpoint; hold expiry yields interrupted exercise_timeout and no later update; deadline uses 30-second grace; sentinel remains alive; no unowned PID is signaled.

cases.name: Restart recovery and reconnect
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Stop service with queued and running jobs, restart same root, pair again and reconcile cached IDs; inject database/digest corruption.
expected: Queued keeps order; active becomes interrupted service_restarted; sessions invalidate; UI shows unknown until snapshot; corruption is read-only recovery with mutations blocked.

cases.name: Bounded ordered event replay
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Produce maximum 2,001 metrics and checkpoints, 32 phases/warnings, 16 progress and terminal; page 500, reconnect SSE with duplicate cursor, then attempt one excess producer event.
expected: All at-most-4,096 events replay once in cursor order; heartbeat has no cursor; SSE closes at bounds; duplicate ignored; excess causes WORKER_PROTOCOL_ERROR without pruning prior events.

cases.name: All operation schemas and semantics
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Submit valid/min/max and one invalid field for each of 15 operations including both tokenizer profiles and context_preview; run both applied adapter presets, verify the frozen validation comparator, run paired sealed evaluation twice, and inspect tokenizer/weight/resume/evaluate/generate effects and artifacts.
Run standard and fixed weight-tied architecture profiles and reject any uploaded or arbitrary architecture code.

Create preview then send unchanged generation; independently recompute canonical_generation_request_sha256 and context_preview_digest from the exact field objects; alter each bound prompt/message/decoding/identity/device field and retry.
expected: Closed schemas enforce bounds; tokenizer profile/type agree and tokenizer creates no weights; the capstone preset is seed 29 and exactly 20 updates; selection orders exact-intent numerator, schema-valid numerator, finite supervised-response mean NLL, then earliest step; inference/evaluation do not update; resume preserves lineage/optimizer/RNG; paired token is consumed once even on interruption.
Only internal architecture profile IDs execute; tokenizer/model/resume/generation semantics remain distinct.
Only unchanged request accepts preview; every altered or corrupt/missing preview is rejected pre-job as CONTEXT_PREVIEW_STALE; preview performs no weight load or inference.

cases.name: CLI/API parity without shell
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Export request.json, submit through CLI and HTTP, compare canonical records; inspect code for shell/eval interpolation; run legacy-equivalence fixture.

Run E01 harness with a nonexistent absolute output directory for exact edit, protected-byte change and one failing test; retry against an existing output path; inspect receipt/log atomicity, control-channel registration and tied training verification binding.
expected: CLI and API records match; learner text never becomes argv/shell; pure-mechanics equivalence fields meet declared tolerance while artifact formats stay distinct.

Exact edit atomically creates the output directory with receipt.json and bounded logs plus one hash-bound registered receipt; existing output exits 2 without mutation, protected diff exits 3, and failed test exits 4; tied training requires verification ID and labels the built-in matching backend without claiming learner source trained.

cases.name: Safe artifact serving
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Request allowlisted small text, 256KiB and 256KiB+1 text, HTML/SVG/notebook/binary, Range, and malicious filename/content.
expected: Only allowlisted text through 256KiB previews; all active/large content attaches with nosniff; Range 416; UI renders text without markup execution.

cases.name: Backend/device/download exactness
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Remove/mismatch each backend; request CUDA per profile; replay exact manifest downloads and alter host/path/query/redirect/count/byte/digest; inject timeout, ENOSPC and OOM.
expected: Preflight reports exact capability/device failure with no fallback; only eight pinned files and redirects pass; any mismatch leaves no model; runtime faults never report success.

cases.name: Export, validate and clean-root import
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Export root A; stage in empty root B; validate then import under skip and copy; corrupt a member; evaluate/generate returned local model.
Export thin and full bundles with per-checkpoint resume-state choices and conversation selection.
expected: Validation is read-only; corrupt import registers nothing; skip/copy identity maps follow data contract; imported provenance remains imported; root B does not read A; reuse works via local IDs.
Thin is non-loadable and omits weights; full includes inference bytes and only explicitly selected resume state; sensitive conversation inclusion is previewed.

cases.name: Truthful post-accept faults
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Inject ENOSPC at artifact and SQLite phases, malformed worker messages, nonfinite metric, bad hash, step mismatch and unexpected exit zero/nonzero.
expected: Every accepted job has exactly one truthful terminal path; committed evidence remains; partial output quarantines; no failed/interrupted path is labelled completed.

cases.name: Audit privacy and UI truth
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
Fixtures and fault controls named by the case are available and hashed.
steps: Submit prompts/messages/secrets and inspect HTTP headers, audit rows, five rotated logs and diagnostic exports; compare UI labels to event snapshots.
Preview then delete note/conversation and inspect tombstone audit.
expected: Logs/audit omit secrets/content/full bodies; request/entity metadata remains; diagnostics are opt-in; running/completed labels require persisted reconciled events.
Deleted content is absent while ID/time/digest audit remains; no other deletion endpoint exists.

cases.name: Native release qualification evidence
preconditions: Target implementation built from the pinned specification revision.
